notes.title: Infinity Imperium: Time War!
notes.content:
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-dsenYyBigyw/X192Ya2gFQI/AAAAAAAAD9U/RXza4r-xNMEoOngrVwTlWEsw3fu5xh62QCLcBGAsYHQ/s1928/sfondo.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-dsenYyBigyw/X192Ya2gFQI/AAAAAAAAD9U/RXza4r-xNMEoOngrVwTlWEsw3fu5xh62QCLcBGAsYHQ/s1928/sfondo.png[/img][/url]

Hi everyone!

Today we want to finally remove the veil of mystery around the latest upgrade made to Infinity Imperium.

An upgrade that screams “Enough!” to all those advices received that caused us to end up often and willingly in dead ends. This long and slaughtering path has now come to an end! Today we present with great pride and joy the new and unique FINAL version of Infinity Imperium!

The images you will already see speak for themselves about the abysmal graphic difference!

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-cfSqRx0avr8/X192zqt5qNI/AAAAAAAAD9k/NTi_mMByGlAy9T_M5EZ7anA6BrQy7DPlgCLcBGAsYHQ/s3359/galassia%2Bprima%2Bdopo.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-cfSqRx0avr8/X192zqt5qNI/AAAAAAAAD9k/NTi_mMByGlAy9T_M5EZ7anA6BrQy7DPlgCLcBGAsYHQ/s3359/galassia%2Bprima%2Bdopo.png[/img][/url]

But that wasn't enough for us! We improved and retouched the gameplay by bringing the gaming experience to what it was supposed to be from the beginning, the ONLY RTS where you can manipulate the TIME and SPACE of an entire GALAXY composed of 1120 planets and 580-star systems!

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-HAr26v9561g/X192-GqTN8I/AAAAAAAAD9s/csOZG4XFXrseJLXcrLtgT32BwQcG9awVACLcBGAsYHQ/s3271/system%2Bprima%2Bdop.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-HAr26v9561g/X192-GqTN8I/AAAAAAAAD9s/csOZG4XFXrseJLXcrLtgT32BwQcG9awVACLcBGAsYHQ/s3271/system%2Bprima%2Bdop.png[/img][/url]

You can travel forward or backward in time and every time you do so you will end up in an alternative reality where everything will be different, for better or worse!

This is INFINITY IMPERIUM and this will mark the beginning of an hexalogy to be discovered!

Stay tuned for further updates
